description: Source code implementing Dobby container management within the Thunder project, including container creation, destruction, status checks, and info retrieval.

classes.name: DobbyContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages Dobby containers, including creation, destruction, initialization, and IPC service setup.

classes.name: DobbyContainer
classes.description: Represents a Dobby container, providing methods to start, stop, and retrieve info about the container.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on search paths and configuration.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Dobby container management, setting up IPC service and proxy.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up IPC service and proxy resources.

methods.name: DestroyContainer
methods.description: Stops and removes a container by name.

methods.name: ContainerNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a container with the given name is already running.

methods.name: containerStopCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container stops, used to fulfill stop promises.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of the container, parsing container info JSON.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory info for the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns processor info for the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interfaces associated with the container (not implemented).

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, optionally with a timeout.
